subject: Post-signature rollout sequencing and evaluation plan — MedSync
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Karen Liu <karen.liu@medsync.org>; MedSync Procurement <procurement@medsync.org>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-signature rollout sequencing and evaluation plan — MedSync

Hi Karen / team,

Congrats again on signing — excited to get MedSync onboarded. Attached is the first draft of the mutual action plan (MAP_MedSync_v1.xlsx) and the evaluation plan (EvalPlan_MedSync_v1.pdf). This email outlines the proposed post-signature sequencing so we can lock dates next week. High-level phases: 

1) Prep & Provisioning (Week 0–1)
  - Private tenant provisioning in us-west-2; KMS key exchange and account-level RBAC.
  - Confirm ingestion S3 endpoint and network egress rules.

2) Canary (Week 2)
  - 48–72 hour controlled canary with a single clinic (100 users/day), read/write traffic mirrored to a test pool.
  - Acceptance metrics: median inference latency < 200ms, 95th percentile < 500ms, error rate < 0.5% for text-gen endpoints.

3) Migration & Ramp (Week 3–5)
  - Incremental onboarding of clinics in 4 waves. Full traffic cutover only after canary signoff.

4) Training & Handoff (Week 3–6)
  - Two instructor-led sessions for Admins + recorded onboarding for clinicians. Training content attached (training_deck_medSync_v1.pptx).

Key asks from MedSync:
- Confirm canary clinic and preferred canary start week (we show Week 2 starting 2027-06-02).
- Provide SOC/HIPAA contact for compliance artifacts (we can push SOC2 snapshot now).
- Lock network egress IPs and KMS details.

Owners:
- Program lead: Priya Natarajan (redwood)
- Ops & canary runbook: Laura Bennett (redwood)
- Training content owner: Marissa Cole (redwood)

Next steps: please review MAP and EvalPlan in Drive (link below) and reply with any date constraints or compliance points by EOD 2027-05-21 so we can finalize the mutual-action timeline and send the DocuSign onboarding SOW.

Attachments (stubs): MAP_MedSync_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), EvalPlan_MedSync_v1.pdf (pdf).

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.ai

Thanks Priya — this looks thorough and reasonable. A few points from our side: 

- Team availability: critical training week has a heavy staff vacation window 2027-06-06 -> 2027-06-12. Can we move instructor-led sessions one week later?
- Compliance: procurement asked for direct SOC2 evidence and a short HIPAA summary for our security team. Can you share the SOC2 snapshot and a HIPAA attestation?
- Canary sizing: would prefer the canary to start a little smaller (50 users/day) — we want to validate behavior on lower volume first then scale to 100.

Quick note — procurement wants the DocuSign SOW routed to procurement@medsync.org and a line-item called "Dedicated Inference Pool (reserved capacity)" to align with our budget code.

Hi Karen — thanks for the quick read. We can absolutely accommodate the asks: 

- Trainer shift: move instructor-led sessions to week starting 2027-06-13 (recordings still available week prior).
- Canary shrink to 50 users/day for first 48 hours, then expand to 100/day during a second 48-hour window if metrics are green.
- DocuSign routing: will route SOW to procurement@medsync.org and include the "Dedicated Inference Pool (reserved capacity)" line item.

SOC2 snapshot: https://www.redwood.com/soc2/SOC2-snapshot-2026.pdf (public snapshot, redacted).
HIPAA attestation: see short attestation text included in EvalPlan_MedSync_v1.pdf; we can pull a custom cover letter if procurement prefers.

Laura + Ben — can you confirm the canary monitoring windows and rollback thresholds below so I can update the MAP?

- Canary acceptance (initial 48h): median latency < 200ms, 95p < 500ms, token error rate < 0.5%;
- If 95p > 700ms or error rate > 1.5% for two consecutive 10-min buckets -> automatic rollback to previous routing policy and notify on-call;
- Metric backstop: manual pause if any customer-affecting errors are observed irrespective of thresholds.

I'll update the Drive MAP and queue the DocuSign envelope once we confirm the dates.

Thanks,
Priya

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Priya / Karen — confirming ops details and adding technical runbook fragments. Summary of canary plan and triggers: 

- Canary plan: two stages — Stage A (pilot): 50 users/day, 48h. Stage B (scale): 100 users/day, 48h.
- Metrics to monitor (real-time): request latency distribution, token consumption per request, 5xx rate by endpoint, model hallucination flags (QA hooks).
- Rollback / pause triggers (automated):
  • 95p latency > 700ms for 20 continuous minutes OR
  • 5xx rate > 1% for 15 continuous minutes OR
  • Any P1 customer-impacting error observed by on-call

- On-call routing: redwood-oncall@pagerduty -> primary ops engineer (Ben Carter) then escalation to platform SRE.
- Region & networking: we'll provision in us-west-2 as requested. Please confirm whether data transfer must remain within a specific VPC peering path vs. full internet egress.

Attachments (stubs): canary_script.yml (monitoring checks), ops_checklist_medSync.csv (preflight), runbook_link: https://drive.redwood.com/runbooks/medsync-canary.

Ben, please confirm you'll cover initial canary windows and the post-stage validation runbook. Marissa, can you confirm training instructor availability for the week of 2027-06-13?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Implementation Ops, Redwood Inference
